title: Registration opens for Intapp Amplify 2027, with Intapp Celeste on the main stage
summary: See Intapp Celeste, the expert AI coworker, run firm workflows at Intapp Amplify this March. Register now to join us in New York, London, or virtually.
body_markdown:
*Firm leaders will see Celeste, the expert AI coworker for professional firms, run conflicts clearance, deal screening, and other firm workflows live in New York on March 3 and London on March 9, with a virtual Asia-Pacific program on March 10*


**PALO ALTO – November 18, 2026 –** Intapp (NASDAQ: INTA), the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries, today opened registration for Intapp Amplify 2027, its annual event for leaders of professional and financial services firms.


As AI tools become standard across professional firms, working faster is no longer a differentiator. What sets firms apart is how well they run the business of the firm. Amplify 2027 will show how Intapp Celeste, the expert AI coworker for professional firms, runs end-to-end workflows that drive growth and competitive advantage.


Amplify takes place Wednesday, March 3, 2027, at Alice Tully Hall, Lincoln Center, in New York, and Tuesday, March 9, 2027, at the Barbican Hall in London. A separate livestream for Asia-Pacific will run Wednesday, March 10.


**Celeste takes the main stage**


Celeste was introduced at Amplify 2026, which drew hundreds of partners and industry leaders in New York and London.


Built on a firm’s own data and operating within existing compliance controls, Celeste delivers Firm AI: AI that handles the business of the firm. Since Celeste became generally available in July 2026, top firms have used it to power firm-level workflows, including conflicts clearance, business development, lateral hiring, and deal screening.


Amplify 2027 moves from announcements to proof. On stage, Celeste will run live business workflows across legal, accounting, consulting, private capital, investment banking and advisory, and real assets. Attendees will see Celeste handle the growth, compliance, and profitability work that keeps a firm running, with its playbooks, data, and governance in full view.


**Who should attend and why**


Amplify is built for the people who run the business of professional firms: COOs, chief AI officers, CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, managing partners, and heads of AI, innovation, and risk.


Attendees will:


- **See Celeste in action:** Watch Celeste run business-of-the-firm workflows end to end, on a trusted, governed platform.
- **Learn from leading firms:** Hear directly from clients about how they’re using Celeste to win and grow business, manage risk, and improve profitability.
- **Explore the future of AI and the business of the firm:** Take part in fireside conversations with business and AI leaders.
- **Discover solutions for your industry:** Visit demo stations and connect with Intapp experts and industry peers.
- **Join the executive program:** Senior leaders in each city can attend an invitation-only VIP session and hospitality.


**How to attend**


Join us in person in New York or London, or virtually for our Asia-Pacific program. Attendance is free, but advance registration is required. Register at[intapp.com/amplify](https://www.intapp.com/amplify) .


Select sessions from the New York and London programs will also be livestreamed. Additional agenda details will be available in January.


**Supporting quote**


**Thad Jampol, Co-Founder and Chief Product Officer, Intapp**


“At Amplify 2026, we introduced Celeste. At Amplify 2027, we’ll show Celeste taking on the business of the firm. The conversation about AI has moved beyond what it might do or the value it might create. Now it’s about putting AI agents to work, from conflicts and time reconstruction to deal screening, with the governance their clients and regulators expect. At Amplify, we’ll show that happening live.”
